verdict.rationale: Sierra's own docs show agents calling APIs and accessing systems: you can inspect API calls, see which systems were accessed, configure systems integrations, and use an MCP gateway that 'safely connects AI agents to the tools and systems.' A hands-on community report confirms it works with customers' internal APIs. However, nothing documents refunds, order changes or subscription updates specifically, and nothing shows scoped authentication per action. missing for 10: documented per-action scoped auth/permissions, explicit transactional action examples (refunds, order or subscription changes), developer docs on the action/tool definition API.

support.subject: As a developer, the agent takes real actions through my APIs — refunds, order changes, subscription updates — with scoped auth per action

citations.quote: Understand and rapidly adjust agent behavior by inspecting API calls, logic traces, and more.
